reviews.t: The Best Makeup Remover I Ever Had
reviews.x: I absolutely luv this stuff I didn’t think my makeup was coming off until I washed my hands. It loosed up my makeup and made it very easy to come off, after I washed it off I followed up with my cleanser after washing that off the shocker happened my face was so Moisturizing from the oil I used witch hazel after patting my face dry and usually I have makeup still on my face after washing but this time I didn’t it completely got all that makeup off my face it wasn’t greasy at all but very smooth

I have used many kinds of cleaning oil including expensive kinds over years. This Biore is considered as the inexpensive drug store kind in Japan, but brought me the biggest satisfaction ever. It cleans my face without drying, and makes my skin feels softer and smoother next morning.  I can tell the difference when I put on my makeup.  Love it!

I don't remember exactly how many years since I used this product, but I am sure it's been more than 15 years. It works, and the price is affordable. There are many similar make-up remover oil products out there but this one is definitely my favorite. Not one of the favorites, THE ONE. I will keep buying it.

I originally bought this at another store (they no longer carry it) and it worked great at getting my makeup off. No irritated skin from scrubbing like when using the makeup wipes. I have since been only using this to remove my makeup. Will continue to purchase as long as it stays available.

I first tried this product in the Philippines. When I came here in the US, I noticed that only Walgreens is selling this item and has to be ordered online. I am glad they have a flagship store in Amazon. A little goes a long way in this product. It removes even the toughest eyeliners and mascaras. This one is for keeps. Worth the price. Love Japan products!
I love that it is easy to remove my makeup even the waterproof mascara. It also doesn't hurt my face when I use the wipe to remove makeup.

reviews.t: Very pleasant and effective skin cleanser which doesn't over wash

The first impression is that the aroma is extremely pleasant, followed by the gentle, slick feel of the liquid against one's skin.  It washes easily, without leaving my dry skin feeling overly tight, or over washed.  I used a light toner after washing one side of my face, my usual products (more expensive), then managed to forget

Biore Cleansing Oil Makeup Removing Cloths come in a package like most wipes and have a pull tab on the top to open and close the packet. There are 44 wipes in each packet and each wipe is about 4.5 x 5.5 inches (you probably would need 2 or 3 wipes a time if you wear a lot of makeup) and is pre-moisturized. This makeup remover jelly is a thin gel like remover that has a slight but pleasant scent to it. I have combination skin and this works nicely for me - no oily residue but also no drying out of my skin after each use. The gel doesn't lather like soap - it is minimal but effective in applying to skin then rinsing. claims.text: Many reviewers say it effectively removes makeup, including tough waterproof mascara and eyeliner.
Several reviewers praise how it leaves skin feeling moisturized, soft, and smooth without drying.
Some reviewers complain about the strong chemical scent and that it burns their eyes.
A few reviewers report negative skin reactions, including worsened acne and unsuitability for dry skin.
Some reviewers mention issues with packaging waste and receiving an expired product.
